_what: The only actions `trillion action SERVICE ACTION 'JSON'` can reach (harness/action-bus.mjs): an AI that can run a shell names a service and an action, and the account runs the Workshop tool the row names on this person's computer through run_tool, with the person's key, so every check the tool and the account make still applies. Nothing outside this list is reachable and nothing here is a shell command. A new action is one row under its service; a service the person's computer does not carry answers in words from the account.

rules.what: set, list and remove recording rules and rights, turn the notice and private mode on or off

dictate.what: turn what was said into clean text and put it where the person is typing

read-link.what: read a meeting link into its service, id and time

open-link.what: open a meeting link in the app that handles it

exclusions.what: list and change what a capture leaves out

hear-sources.what: list and choose the sounds a recording hears

suggest-zooms.what: suggest where a recording should zoom

words.say_the_service: Name the service and the action: trillion action SERVICE ACTION 'JSON'. Run trillion actions to list them.
words.unknown_service: No service called {service}. The services are: {services}.
words.unknown_action: {service} has no action called {action}. Its actions are: {actions}.
words.not_an_object: The input is one JSON object, for example '{"action":"list"}'.
